questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Dalton: PA/P=nA/(nA+nB)=(7)/(3×(7))=⅓। বিকল্পগুলো PA/P-এর মান।

questions.question_bn: Same pendulum planet A period 20s,planet Bperiod 10s। gB/gA কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। T∝1/√g sameL。 gB/gA=(TA/TB)²=2²=4; period ratio inverted and squared।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Planet-এর GM/R=10 J/kg। surface থেকে radius 2R-এ প্রতি kg তুলতে work কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Potential V=−GM/r। ΔV=−GM/(2R)+GM/R=GM/(2R)=(10)/2; quasistatic external work positive।

questions.question_bn: HeaterR 10Ωat constant 100 V heatswatermass 9 kg,c4200 J/kgK। idealΔT10Ktime কত s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। P=V²/R=1000 W। requiredQ=mcΔT=42000nJ⇒t=Q/P=42ns,heatinglossesneglected。
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: একই distance-এর প্রথম half speed 7, দ্বিতীয় half speed 14 m/s। average speed কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Equal distances-এ harmonic mean 2v₁v₂/(v₁+v₂)=4×(7)/3। arithmetic mean শুধু equal times-এ।

questions.question_bn: Twoconvergingthinlensf₁=f₂=7 cm,separation 7 cm। equivalentfocallength কত cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Equivalent power 1/F=1/f₁+1/f₂−d/(f₁f₂)=2/(7)−1/(7)=1/(7)। separatedlenscontactsumincorrect।

questions.question_bn: r=(4,1,0) m, F=(0,2,3) N। torque-এর z-component কত N·m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Torque r×F। z-component rx Fy−ry Fx=(4)·2−1·0=2×(4); dot product নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Laminar flow tube length L→3L, radius r→2r, same viscosity। hydraulic resistance ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Poiseuille R∝L/r⁴। ratio=(3)/(2⁴)=(3)/16; radius squared নয় fourth power।

questions.question_bn: Parallel long wires same direction currents I ও 4I, separation d। attraction নাকি repulsion?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Same-direction parallel currents attract; opposite currents repel। current ratio magnitude বদলায়, sign নয়।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=4D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: Element isotopes masses 42 ও 44u, abundance 75% ও 25%। relative atomic mass কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Weighted mean 0.75((22)+20)+0.25((22)+22)=(22)+20.5u। সমান average (22)+21 abundance উপেক্ষা করে।

questions.question_bn: 900g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: 9 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। 2ROH+2Na→2RONa+H₂। alcohol:H₂=2:1; H atom pair করে gas, তাই (9)/2 mol।

questions.question_bn: Molten NaCl electrolysis,total charge 13F। Cl₂moles কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Anode 2Cl⁻→Cl₂+2e⁻। equalcircuitchargegivesn/2 mol Cl₂; aqueouscompetingreactionsexcludedby moltencondition।

questions.explanation: Many gas dissolution exothermic; warming dissolved gas escape favour করে। gases/conditions-specific exceptions থাকলেও ordinary trend decrease।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂। pure CaCO₃400g,100%conversion। Ca Oyield কত g? MCaO 56

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 17×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 20mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=3, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Propene+HBr, per oxide present। major product কী?

questions.question_bn: কোন aqueous ion normally colourless d-shell reasoning-এ?
questions.explanation: Zn²⁺ d¹⁰ filled shell; usual d-d transitions absent। Cu²⁺d9,Ni²⁺d8,Co²⁺d7 visible absorption দিতে পারে।

questions.question_bn: Rate=k[A]²[B]। [A] 9 গুণ,[B] half হলে rate ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Rate factor=((9))²×(½)=(9)²/2। coefficient/stoichiometry দিয়ে order replace করা যাবে না।

questions.question_bn: ConductanceG=17S,cellconstantl/A=2 cm⁻¹। conductivityκ কত S/cm?

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 25 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 17mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C5H8। total sigma-bond count কত?

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 15L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=13 mol,H₂=26 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(13))/3,availableN₂(13) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(13)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=11M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(11)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((11)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CO poisoning-এ প্রধান binding target কী?
questions.explanation: CO haemoglobin-এর সঙ্গে strong binding করে oxygen transport কমায়; কম concentration-এও serious exposure risk থাকে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Reaction-এ bonds broken total 1000kJ/mol, formed 1200kJ/mol। approximate ΔH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Bond enthalpy estimate ΔH=Σbroken−Σformed=100×(10)−120×(10)=−20×(10); bond formation releases energy।
